video_title: Post Game Press Conference l Isaiah Joe l Pistons vs Bucks  l 11.27.26 #NBA

quotes.speaker: Isaiah Joe
quotes.summary_phrase: Isaiah Joe on the team's collective defensive effort and transition play
quotes.excerpt: when we can do that collectively as a group, it's tough to score on us.
quotes.quote: The overall game felt good. Not only for myself, but once that second unit got out there, we got to be back ourselves and it just trickled down to everybody. The rest of the game we kind of held that energy, that composure. We hang our hats on the defensive end, and so when we can do that collectively as a group, it's tough to score on us when we're limiting teams to one shot, getting rebounds, getting out in transition, and turning the tide that way. That's how we get some of our bread and butter, and when we're at a deficit like that, that's how we're able to get back into the game by buying in.
quotes.social_post: Isaiah Joe says the second unit energy was the turning point for the Pistons tonight. He credits their defensive composure and transition play for helping them climb back into the game.

structured.context: Isaiah Joe discusses the team's defensive performance and transition play following a game.

quotes.speaker: Isaiah Joe
quotes.summary_phrase: Isaiah Joe on the value of competitive regular season games
quotes.excerpt: I think these are some of the most competitive games during the regular season.
quotes.quote: It's a good opportunity to test your group. I think these are some of the most competitive games during the regular season. They give you that playoff feel, and so taking these seriously and really trying to get better each and every game so we can look back at the end of the season and learn from it. The energy is unmatched, the way the teams approach the games is a little different, and so that'll give us a good taste of what it's going to be like in postseason.
quotes.social_post: Isaiah Joe on the intensity of the current stretch of games: These are some of the most competitive games during the regular season. They give you that playoff feel.

structured.context: Isaiah Joe reflects on the competitive nature of regular season games and their importance for postseason preparation.

quotes.speaker: Isaiah Joe
quotes.summary_phrase: Isaiah Joe on the team's next-man-up mentality and player contributions
quotes.excerpt: Everybody has that next man up mentality, and it's showing out there.
quotes.quote: Everybody has that next man up mentality, and it's showing out there. You got guys like Elijah Harkless coming out and playing big minutes, he's been a big lift for us. Chaz is doing amazing, even with spot minutes. Everybody is taking on the extra role that they've been given and playing free. Everybody is going out there playing free, playing selfless, and it shows. Nobody is going out there shying away, everybody is confident in what they do. We put a lot of work into our craft, and that next man up mentality is very dangerous. We use it to our advantage.
quotes.social_post: Isaiah Joe praises the depth of the Pistons roster: Everybody is taking on the extra role that they have been given and playing free. That next man up mentality is very dangerous.

structured.context: Isaiah Joe praises the team's next-man-up mentality and the contributions of teammates like Elijah Harkless.

quotes.speaker: Isaiah Joe
quotes.summary_phrase: Isaiah Joe on his process as a movement shooter
quotes.excerpt: the best part of getting some time on your belt with the guys is learning when to exploit certain actions.
quotes.quote: I just try to stay as active as I can. The best part of getting some time on your belt with the guys is learning when to exploit certain actions, when to run off, when to space. I think we do a good job as a unit of moving the ball, screening away, so it's pretty seamless out there, especially when we get rolling and rocking and then you mix in some transition with that. I keep it simple, but I just try to make sure to stay active, but also read what we have out there.
quotes.social_post: Isaiah Joe breaks down his approach as a movement shooter: I keep it simple, but I just try to make sure to stay active, but also read what we have out there.

structured.context: Isaiah Joe explains his process and movement as a shooter within the team's offensive system.

quotes.speaker: Isaiah Joe
quotes.summary_phrase: Isaiah Joe on ignoring external tracking of point differentials
quotes.excerpt: when we're out on the floor, we just worry about ourselves.
quotes.quote: We leave that to them, but when we're out on the floor, we just worry about ourselves. If we play the brand of basketball that we know how to play, everything else falls into place. If we were to go out there and win like we won and still lost the point differential, we just tip our hats and we learn and move on. But if we just go out there and play our brand of basketball, we leave that to the coaches and are not worried about it.
quotes.social_post: Isaiah Joe says the players are ignoring external point differential talk: We leave that to them, but when we are out on the floor, we just worry about ourselves.

structured.context: Isaiah Joe explains that the players focus on their own brand of basketball rather than external statistics like point differentials.
